patch_list: Disables the Play PairIP license check that forces a re-signed build to the Play Store on launch. Required for a sideloaded (non-root) install of the patched APK.
Remove cross-promotion (Prime Button and game icons)

Removes the "Prime Button" and the six side-panel game icons from the Unity menu scenes (data.unity3d). The objects are deactivated and scaled to zero, so the menu scripts cannot bring them back at runtime. AdMob banner, interstitial and r…

Removes the AdMob banner ads shown on the home screen pages. All Java entry points (DeviceManager, AdManager, AdmobAdapter) are blocked, so no banner view is created or shown. The area simply shows the black Unity background afterwards.
